fields.gap: Holding p_int at a 1000 Pa ceiling takes 46.3 L/s there, 527 to 844 W real, and a QUESTIONABLE 150 to 400 kg pump set: 61 to 164 percent of the whole 244.472 kg float margin. The ceiling itself is an owner assumption; commissioning pump-down is 506 kWh.
fields.direction: Shop a real Roots or screw pump specification at this duty (mass, power, intake pressure curve); set the operational p_int ceiling from the leak budget; consider distributed smaller pumps or a ground-only pump.
fields.effect: Trades directly against the margin; can exceed it entirely at the conservative end.
